doc.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005

title: Hearing 'I'm Forever Blowing Bubbles' in Thomas, near Birmingham
summary: Corrects the place of the Bubbles memory: Thomas, a suburb of Birmingham, at about eight or nine.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well let me ask you about when you were in Chicago, as a boy, you said you recalled hearing a particular song that never left your memory. Remember we were just talking about that?
Oh no, that was in Birmingham.

Well to be exact, it was a suburb of Birmingham. Thomas. T-H-O-M-A-S. Thomas is just a streetcar ride from Birmingham. And I’ve never forgot, there was an airplane with the tail, a flag, “I’m Forever Blowing Bubbles.” And I never forgot that. I must have been about eight, nine years old.
